tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Fast, efficient screenshot capture of web pages - optimized for CLI coding tools. Use this after performing updates to web pages to ensure your changes are displayed correctly. Automatically tiles full pages into 1072x1072 chunks for optimal processing.

fullPage.description: Capture full page screenshot with tiling. If false, only the viewport is captured.

waitUntil.description: Wait until event: load, domcontentloaded, networkidle0, networkidle2

directory.description: Save tiled screenshots to a local directory (returns file paths instead of base64)

tools.name: take_screencast
tools.description: Capture a series of screenshots of a web page over time, producing a screencast. Uses adaptive frame rates: 100ms intervals for ≤5s, 200ms for 5-10s, 500ms for >10s. PNG format: individual frames. WebP format: animated WebP with 4-second pause at end for looping.

duration.description: Total duration of screencast in seconds

oneOf.description: Single JavaScript code to execute after the first screenshot
Array of JavaScript instructions - screenshot taken before each one

jsEvaluate.description: JavaScript code to execute. String: single instruction after first screenshot. Array: takes screenshot before each instruction, then continues capturing until duration ends.

waitUntil.description: Wait until event: load, domcontentloaded, networkidle0, networkidle2

directory.description: Save screencast to directory. Specify format with "format" parameter.

format.description: Output format when using directory: "png" for individual PNG files, "webp" for animated WebP (default)

quality.description: WebP quality level (only applies when format is "webp"): low (50), medium (75), high (90)

tools.name: capture_selector
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a specific DOM element matched by a CSS selector. Use this when a full-page screenshot would send unnecessary pixels.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to capture

waitUntil.description: Wait until event: load, domcontentloaded, networkidle0, networkidle2

selectorTimeoutMS.description: How long to wait for the selector to appear before failing

tools.name: capture_console
tools.description: Capture console output from a web page. Accepts a URL, optional JS command to run, and duration to wait (default 4 seconds). Returns all console messages during that time.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL to capture console from

jsCommand.description: Optional JavaScript command to execute on the page

duration.description: Duration to capture console output in seconds

waitUntil.description: Wait until event: load, domcontentloaded, networkidle0, networkidle2
